# acloud_nodepool_join_config (Data Source)

Provides access to node join configuration for a node pool. Can be used in combination with other terraform providers to provision new Kubernetes Nodes for [Bring Your Own Node](https://docs.avisi.cloud/product/kubernetes/bring-your-own-node/) clusters in Avisi Cloud Kubernetes.

With Bring Your Own Node clusters you can retrieve [join configuration](https://docs.avisi.cloud/docs/how-to/kubernetes-bring-your-own-node/join-nodes-to-cluster/) for new nodes in the form of userdata or install scripts.
This datasource only works for Bring Your Own Node clusters, and requires admin permissions in the organisation.

~> **Sensitive outputs:** `user_data`, `kubelet_config`, `join_command`, `install_script` and `upgrade_script` contain credentials that allow a node to join the cluster (base64 encoding does not protect them). They are marked as sensitive, which hides them in plan and apply output, but they are still stored in plain text in the Terraform state. Use a state backend with encryption at rest and restrict access to the state accordingly.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster` (String) Slug of the cluster
- `environment` (String) Slug of the environment of the cluster
- `node_pool_id` (String) Numeric ID of the node pool, for example `acloud_nodepool.example.id`. This is not the UUID `identity` of the node pool.

### Optional

- `organisation` (String) Slug of the Organisation. Defaults to the organisation configured in the provider.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The numeric ID of the node pool, same as `node_pool_id`.
- `install_script` (String, Sensitive) Install bash script for joining a node (base64).
- `join_command` (String, Sensitive) Command for joining a node to the cluster.
- `kubelet_config` (String, Sensitive) Kubelet configuration (base64).
- `upgrade_script` (String, Sensitive) Install bash script for upgrading a node (base64).
- `user_data` (String, Sensitive) Cloud Init user-data (base64).
